evidence: The continuous rings of ring_bundle.json with a 1.0 km radius step with continuous low-thrust keeping over twelve orbits of each ring's semi-major-axis step, eccentricity vector and plane about its phase-matched neighbour toward the middle ring, which flies free, measured with exact elements; time constant thirty minutes, 0.001 m/s^2 limit. Control use is the time integral of the control acceleration sampled every minute. Forces, copies and checks are those of stage 2b; the interior clearance leaves out the two edge rings. The gravity-only case keeps the same rings under gravity alone (finite-square quadrature, no light) and splits its control into radial, along-track and normal parts, each integrated in magnitude.
reading_rule: A kept bundle passes when no sample falls below 150 m and the service overlaps stay positive; the velocity spent per ring per orbit is the per-tile keeping cost of that ring. Ring 18 is the bundle's unshadowed top edge.
